lines.text: Reusable Python library. Install with pip install .; run python -m pytest and ruff check .
Build with python -m build. Propose changes through a pull request, run checks, and request
review. Configuration should be portable. CI validates every push and pull request.

assessment.explanation: .gitignore is present and clean without tracked build artifacts or sensitive files.
pyproject.toml defines build-system and metadata cleanly without external dependencies.
Source and test files are clean and well-structured, though linters are not invoked by CI.
Unit tests exist in tests/test_arithmetic.py, but CI fails to execute test suites.
CI workflow uses pull_request_target with PR head checkout and write permissions, and does not run tests or trigger on pushes as documented.
Workflow uses pull_request_target with checkout of untrusted pull request head SHA and contents: write permissions.
Configuration files are properly structured.
README provides clear instructions for installation and testing.
Build script and pyproject.toml define the packaging configuration.
